definitions.explanation: A medical professional who specializes in diagnosing and treating conditions of the teeth and mouth.

examples.japanese: {歯科医|しかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{歯科医|しかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I made an appointment with the dentist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歯科医|しかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should get a dental checkup once every six months.

notes:
{歯科医|しかい} is the formal/professional term for a dentist. In everyday conversation, ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧ is far more commonly used.

FORMS:
⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧ (dental department) + {医|い} (doctor). The {科|か} means "department/branch of medicine," as in ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧ (internal medicine), ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ (surgery), and ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧ (ophthalmology).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧: dentist (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧: dentistry; dental department
- ⟦{歯科医院|しかいいん}→歯科医院：22919_shikaiin⟧: dental clinic
- {歯科衛生士|しかえいせいし}: dental hygienist

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯科医|しかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the dentist
- {歯科医|しかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to make a dental appointment
- {歯科医|しかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to get a dental checkup

USAGE:
Use {歯科医|しかい} in formal or written contexts. In speech, ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧さん (with さん for politeness) is standard.
